name: Recital AJ
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: AJ. whereas the EU should not pursue policies that harm the interests of EU citizens; whereas the EU establishment is consistently pushing for the rapid conclusion and ratification of the EU-Mercosur Partnership Agreement, which violates the interests of food consumers and farmers in the EU; whereas this Mercosur policy is being deliberately pursued in a way that fails to guarantee EU citizens the quality and affordability of food production at European standards, and in a way in which protective mechanisms depend on the goodwill of the Commission, and remain merely reactive to damage caused by the implementation of the agreement;
